name: API Development & Testing Platform - Feature-Benefit-Tie Down

prompt.main: Create a 60-second technical product demo for an API development and testing platform using Feature-Benefit-Tie Down framework. Target: developers and engineering teams. Show 4 core features with clear benefits and developer-focused tie-downs. (1) Collaborative API design with OpenAPI auto-generation—design APIs as a team, docs generate automatically. Benefit: No more doc/code drift. Tie-down: 'Accurate docs save hours of support, right?' (2) Automated testing across environments with AI-generated test cases. Benefit: Catch bugs before production. Tie-down: 'Prevention beats firefighting, doesn't it?' (3) Real-time API monitoring with intelligent alerts. Benefit: Know when things break, why they broke. Tie-down: 'Fast resolution keeps users happy, right?' (4) Developer portal auto-generation. Benefit: Beautiful docs and sandbox without manual work. Tie-down: 'Great DX means faster adoption, doesn't it?' Use dark mode UI, code syntax highlighting, terminal aesthetics, subtle animations, developer-friendly vibe.
prompt.opening: Terminal window showing failed API request: '500 Internal Server Error'. Developer's frustrated sigh. Split screen: Writing code, updating docs manually, testing in Postman, checking logs in 3 different tabs, updating changelog. Text: 'Building APIs shouldn't be this hard.' Quick cut to clean, unified API platform interface.
prompt.middle:
FEATURE 1 - Collaborative API Design (12s):
Visual: Team designing REST API endpoints in visual editor. OpenAPI spec generates in real-time. Another dev adds authentication requirements. Schema validation runs automatically. Export button generates complete documentation.
Voiceover: 'Design your APIs collaboratively with visual editors and automatic OpenAPI spec generation—which means your documentation always matches your implementation—and accurate docs save your team hours of support questions, don't they?'
On-screen: 'Collaborative Design → Auto-Generated Docs → Zero Drift'
Tie-down visual: Support tickets graph declining

FEATURE 2 - Automated Testing (12s):
Visual: Developer writes one test. AI suggests 15 additional edge cases. All tests run across dev, staging, production environments simultaneously. Results dashboard shows: 47 tests passed, 2 failed in staging (caught before production!). Failed test shows exact request/response with diff highlighting.
Voiceover: 'AI-powered test generation runs comprehensive tests across all environments—catching bugs before your users do—and prevention beats firefighting at 3 AM, doesn't it?'
On-screen: 'AI Test Generation → Multi-Environment → Catch Bugs Early'
Tie-down visual: Production incidents graph trending down

FEATURE 3 - Real-Time Monitoring (12s):
Visual: Live API dashboard showing request rates, latency, error rates. Sudden spike in 500 errors. Alert fires immediately: 'Database connection pool exhausted'. Distributed tracing shows exact request path where it failed. Error context includes recent deployments, infrastructure changes.
Voiceover: 'Real-time monitoring with intelligent alerts tells you exactly what broke and why—so you fix issues in minutes, not hours—and fast resolution keeps users happy and retention high, right?'
On-screen: 'Smart Monitoring → Instant Alerts → Fast Resolution'
Tie-down visual: MTTR (Mean Time To Resolution) dropping from hours to minutes

FEATURE 4 - Auto-Generated Developer Portal (12s):
Visual: Click 'Generate Portal'. Beautiful developer documentation site appears: Interactive API reference, code examples in 7 languages, live sandbox environment where developers can test calls, authentication guides. Developer from external company using the portal, testing API calls, successfully integrating.
Voiceover: 'One-click developer portal generation gives you beautiful docs and interactive sandboxes—making integration effortless for your API consumers—and great developer experience means faster adoption and fewer support tickets, doesn't it?'
On-screen: 'Auto Portal → Interactive Docs → Faster Adoption'
Tie-down visual: API adoption rate growing, integration time reduced
prompt.closing: Montage of all features working together: Team designing API, tests running automatically, monitoring catching issues, partners integrating via portal. Metrics overlay: 'Development Speed: +45%', 'API Downtime: -87%', 'Integration Time: -60%'. Developer closes laptop at 5 PM confidently. End card: '[Platform] - APIs Done Right · Start Free Trial'. Clean, minimalist design with code-style monospace font.
visualGuidelines: Dark mode UI throughout (developers prefer dark themes)
Code syntax highlighting: Use realistic code examples
Terminal aesthetic: Monospace fonts, green/blue accent colors
Show real developer workflows: IDE, terminal, browser, all in shot
API requests/responses shown in proper JSON format
Subtle animations: API calls traveling, tests running, data flowing
Use actual developer tools in background: VS Code, Docker, Kubernetes
Typography: Monospace fonts for code, clean sans-serif for UI
Color scheme: Dark background with cyan, green, orange accents

keyFeatures.benefit: Team designs together, docs always accurate, no drift
Comprehensive tests generated automatically, bugs caught early
Know what broke, why it broke, fix it fast
Beautiful docs and sandbox, faster partner integration

painPoints: Documentation drift from actual API behavior
Production issues discovered by users first
Scattered tools (design, testing, monitoring all separate)

inspirations.whatMakesItGreat: Clear feature demonstrations, developer-focused, shows real workflows
Shows collaborative design process, emphasizes documentation quality
Beautiful developer portal examples, focus on DX (developer experience)

variations: 90s version: Add sections on versioning, SDK generation, webhook testing
GraphQL-focused: Show GraphQL-specific features and tooling
Enterprise version: Emphasize security, compliance, governance, SSO
Open-source focus: Show GitHub integration, community contribution workflows

technicalSpecs.colorGrading: Dark theme with high contrast, cyan and orange accents, code-style aesthetic
